open.name: Tonbo Imaging India
about: Incorporated in December 2003, Tonbo Imaging India Limited is a global defence electronics original equipment manufacturer (OEM) engaged in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced electro-optic, infrared (EO/IR), embedded vision, communication, guidance, and surveillance systems for defence and security applications. The company offers a diversified portfolio of battlefield solutions, including thermal imaging systems, weapon sights, missile seekers, fire control systems, missile guidance systems, targeting systems, and handheld thermal imaging devices.

Products: Tactical systems: These systems are focused on the functions of imaging, surveillance, reconnaissance and targeting.

Platform systems: Two kinds of platform systems – (a) subsystems that can provide observation and fire control capabilities to a range of aerial, ground and weapon platforms and (b) end platforms that actually perform the task of threat neutralization.

Directed energy systems: To counter the threat of drone swarms, they have designed a portfolio of technology components that are being assembled into a high power microwave (“HPM”) platform with the brand name - WaveStrike.
Key Strengths: Leading defence electronics OEM with proprietary electro-optic and thermal imaging technologies.
Strong in-house R&D capabilities with complete ownership of core intellectual property.
Diversified portfolio of battlefield surveillance, targeting, guidance, and imaging solutions.
Global presence with 28,000+ deployed systems across 24 countries and ITAR-free export capability.
Asset-light, innovation-driven business model supported by healthy financial performance.
Experienced management team with deep expertise in defence technology and product development.

open.name: Bonfiglioli Transmissions
about: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Ltd is one of India’s leading technology-driven companies providing mechanical and electro-mechanical power transmission and industrial drive solutions. The company designs and manufactures high-precision, mission-critical gearboxes and drive systems that are used across a wide range of industries.

Product Portfolio: Its product portfolio includes low, medium and heavy duty gear motors and gearboxes in torque capacities ranging from 13 Nm to 1,400 kNm Helical, bevel, planetary and worm gearboxes and gear motors, electric motors; variable frequency drives, servo motors and drives, and precision drives for robotics & automation solutions.

The business serves three main market segments based on end-use applications, including Industry and Automation Solutions, Off-Highway Mobility, and Wind Industry. In the Industry and Automation Solutions segment, it is among the largest manufacturers of gearboxes and drives in India, serving both original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and end-users.

In India, it operates three manufacturing facilities—two in Tamil Nadu (Thirumudivakkam and Mannur) and one in Maharashtra (Talegaon). Together, these facilities produced over 341,133 gear motors and gearboxes in Fiscal 2025. As of June 30, 2026, we had 215 suppliers in India and 70 suppliers outside India.

The company also offers strong after-sales support through two dedicated channels. This includes a team of in-house service engineers based at our 13 sales offices across India, with three offices located at the manufacturing sites in Thirumudivakkam, Mannur, and Talegaon.

As of June 30, 2026, the company had 71 touchpoints for customer sales and service across India, including three manufacturing facilities, 13 sales offices, 13 authorized third-party service facilities and 44 authorized dealers with 54 outlets. As of June 30, 2026 the company a network of 285 suppliers of which 215 were located in India and 70 were located overseas including in Italy, China, USA and Germany.
As of June 30, 2026, the company had 1,032 personnel involved in various aspects of our operations, which includes onroll employees and contract workers.

about: Incorporated in 2017, Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Private Limited is a technology-led global manufacturing platform. The Company operates as a managed marketplace connecting industrial and consumer enterprises with a global network of manufacturing partners for custom and large-scale production requirements. The company serves across sizes, from innovative startups to mature companies, and across industries, including utilities, renewables, consumer electronics, artificial intelligence infrastructure, aerospace, space & defence, oil & gas, and industrial automation.

The Company follows an asset-light business model and provides end-to-end solutions, including design, supplier matching, quality control, and logistics. The Company’s proprietary platform, Zetwerk OS, enables real-time tracking and transparency across the manufacturing lifecycle. Its key strengths include scalable manufacturing capacity, strong quality control systems, faster delivery timelines, and a diversified global customer base.

It operates across key sectors such as electronics, renewable energy, aerospace and defence, capital goods, and precision manufacturing. Zetwerk has a presence in over 25 countries and a network of 10,000+ suppliers and 1,100+ customers, including Fortune 500 companies. It also operates 20+ manufacturing facilities across India, the United States, and Mexico.
In Fiscal 2026, the company had 1,802 customers, comprising 1,613 customers within India and 189 customers outside India.

open.name: Sahajanand Medical Technologies
about: Incorporated in October 2001, Sahajanand Medical Technologies Limited is a medical technology company engaged in the development, manufacturing and marketing of technologically advanced medical devices, primarily focused on vascular intervention and structural heart intervention. Its product portfolio includes coronary stents, coronary balloons, transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) devices, occluders, renal stents and peripheral drug-coated balloons (DCBs). The Company focuses on research and development, precision manufacturing and clinically supported product innovation. Its flagship brands include Supraflex Cruz, Cocoon and Hydra, serving different areas of interventional cardiology.

The Company operates three manufacturing facilities, two in India and one in Thailand, supported by two R&D centres in India and Thailand. As of June 30, 2026, it had 119 patents granted globally, 78 patent applications in the pipeline and five design registrations in India. Its products were marketed in 77 countries in Fiscal 2026, through direct, hybrid and distributor-led models, with established market presence in India, Europe and other international markets.
The Company reported revenue from operations of ₹12,105.04 million in Fiscal 2026, compared with ₹10,248.79 million in Fiscal 2025 and ₹9,016.04 million in Fiscal 2024.
As of June 30, 2026, it had 1,605 full-time employees, 31 consultants and 707 contract-based employees.

Strong research and development capabilities.
Diversified and integrated manufacturing facilities.
Leadership in India and key international markets.

about: Incorporated in May 2012, Shellz India Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of confectionery products and the manufacturing and supply of food and bakery ingredients. Its product portfolio comprises over 300 SKUs across multiple categories, catering to consumers in urban, semi-urban and rural markets.The Company markets its consumer products under two brands, Hugs and Tosca. The Hugs portfolio includes baked treats, choco delights, jellies, and panned and sugar confectionery, primarily positioned at mass-market price points, with most products priced at ₹10 or below. The Tosca brand focuses on the mass-premium segment through differentiated product formats and packaging, with an emphasis on e-commerce and quick-commerce channels. Its portfolio also includes Tosca Oat Choco, an oat and cereal-based bar developed as an alternative to traditional confectionery products.

The Company's distribution network comprises over 300 super stockists, with products available through kirana outlets across approximately 24 states in India, as of March 31, 2026. In addition to its own brands, the Company undertakes private-label manufacturing for third-party customers and exports products to international markets, including the Middle East, South Asia and Europe. Its operations are supported by in-house manufacturing, product development, research and development, and quality assurance capabilities.
As of August 31, 2026, the Company had 258 full-time employees, including personnel across production, sales, finance, engineering, research and development, quality assurance and other functions.

Competitive Strengths: Super stockist-led distribution model enabling scalable market reach.
Ability to develop differentiated products across formats and price points.
In-house product development capabilities supported by technical expertise.
Presence in the mass-market segment supported by a diversified product portfolio.
Integrated in-house manufacturing capabilities with a focus on scalability and process control.

about: Incorporated on November 15, 2019, Jio Platforms Limited is a technology company focused on digital connectivity, digital services and technology-led solutions in India. The Company has developed proprietary digital technology and pan-India connectivity infrastructure to support the delivery of digital services to consumers and businesses. Its subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm Limited, served 533.3 million customers as of June 30, 2026.The Company operates through an integrated technology platform encompassing digital connectivity, consumer applications, enterprise solutions, cloud services, Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI). Its consumer offerings include mobile and fixed broadband, digital entertainment, cloud storage, virtual PC services and smart home solutions. For businesses, it provides enterprise connectivity, cloud and security solutions, managed services, IoT applications and AI-based solutions. The Company’s proprietary technology capabilities span network infrastructure, device engineering, software, operating systems and digital applications.

The Company’s infrastructure includes pan-India 4G and 5G connectivity, fibre connectivity across more than 1,200 facilities and over 100 edge nodes within its networks as of June 30, 2026. Its wireless broadband network covered more than 99% of India’s population. The Company and its subsidiaries had filed 7,220 patent applications, of which 1,043 had been granted, as of June 30, 2026. Its technology initiatives include an indigenous 5G technology stack, proprietary AI platform JioBrain and fixed wireless access technology. The Company also leverages a nationwide distribution network and partnerships to expand access to digital services.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 27,932 full-time employees and engaged 63,795 personnel on a contract basis. Its workforce includes teams across digital products and technology development, business operations, sales and distribution, customer service, network operations, and corporate functions.

Competitive Strengths: Leadership in digital connectivity and services across India.
Diversified portfolio of consumer and enterprise digital services.
Large and highly engaged customer base with nationwide reach.
Nationwide digital distribution network and strategic group synergies.
Proven ability to scale operations and deploy new technologies rapidly.
Extensive pan-India network infrastructure with 4G and 5G capabilities.
Proprietary technology platform with in-house engineering and full-stack capabilities.
Strong innovation capabilities supported by patents, AI and technology development.

about: Incorporated in1987, Paras Healthcare Limited is a leading clinical specialty-led hospital platform providing tertiary and quaternary healthcare services across North India, Bihar, and Jharkhand under the "Paras Health" brand. The company operates eight hospitals with an aggregate bed capacity of 2,211 beds across Gurugram, Panchkula, Patna, Darbhanga, Kanpur, Udaipur, Ranchi, and Srinagar as of June 30, 2026.
It specializes in cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, gastro sciences, orthopedics & sports injury, and renal sciences (CONGOR specialties), which contributed 75.30% of revenue in Fiscal 2026.

Paras Healthcare has over 20 years of operating history and follows a balanced growth strategy through mature, emerging, and new hospitals. The company plans to expand its network with a 300-bed hospital in Gurugram and a 500-bed hospital in Ludhiana, increasing total capacity to 3,011 beds by March 2028.
As of March 31, 2026, it had 4,670 employees, including 1,084 doctors and 1,937 nurses.
